verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never shows a built-in security awareness training module that is assigned on hire and tracked to completion within Vanta. The only related mention is that the Vanta API can automate evidence collection from external security awareness training systems. That is an integration building block, not the built-in training capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an operations lead, security awareness training is built in — assigned on hire, tracked to completion, and accepted as audit evidence

citations.quote: The Vanta API lets you automate evidence collection and testing across a wide range of system categories, including security awareness training
